---
name: Documentation
about: Report missing, unclear, stale, or incorrect documentation
title: "[Docs] "
labels: "docs"
---

## Problem

What is missing, misleading, duplicated, stale, or classified incorrectly?

## Document kind

Choose one: tutorial / how-to / runbook / reference / explanation / decision / historical / index.

## Lifecycle

Current state: current / experimental / planned / historical / retired.

## Source of truth

Which code, config, tests, workflow, canonical Issue, or ADR proves the expected behavior?

## Expected outcome

What should a user, operator, or contributor be able to understand or do after the fix?

## Affected pages

List existing files or the intended canonical destination.

## Acceptance evidence

How will we prove the documentation is correct? Distinguish local/CI evidence from live production verification.

## Scope guard

What must not be changed or duplicated?
